suitableFor: text-only page intro heroes with heading + subheading + single CTA
landing/listing page intros on secondary-section backgrounds
simple content-driven hero sections without imagery
notSuitableFor: full-bleed image banners with text overlay (use hero-banner)
hero with single side image + 2 CTAs (use hero-blog)
blog/article detail headers with breadcrumbs + byline (use hero-blog-post)
homepage hero with stacked side images (use hero-trendsetters)
